title: Deity of Christ
definition: The deity of Christ means that Jesus Christ is truly and eternally God, sharing the divine nature, glory, authority, and worship that belong to God alone.
summary: The New Testament presents Christ as Creator, Sustainer, Lord, Judge, Savior, and worthy of worship. His deity is central to the Gospel because only God can finally save, forgive, and reconcile sinners to Himself.
christFocus: Looking to Christ is looking to God revealed. The cross is not the work of a mere teacher, but the saving work of the Lord of glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christ receives divine names and honors.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Christ performs divine works, including creation, sustaining all things, forgiving sins, and judging the world.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Faith rests securely in Him because He is not merely sent by God; He is God the Son sent for us.
